Package arztis.econnector.ihe.utilities

Class ElgaAreaConfig

java.lang.Object
arztis.econnector.ihe.utilities.ElgaAreaConfig
public class ElgaAreaConfig
extends java.lang.Object
This class includes all data, which are important for ELGA area configuration. It may be extended in the future if additional differences arise for ELGA areas
At the moment (2020-07-09) there are differences for "urn:oid:" prefixes and content types.
OID of an ELGA area serves as unique identifier in this class.
Author:
Anna Jungwirth
